planets.name: TOI-1450 A b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1450 A with a 2.04-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-1450 A b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1450 A. Its orbit and size follow Brady et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
